the proposed shrinkage estimator improves the estimation of log-oddds ratios for mobility tables and that, for mobility tables with more categories than two, an adjusted estimator of a summary measure of association based on the Altham indices provides an improved assessment of the degree of social fluidy.
the shrinkage estimates outperform the usual estimates in terms of both total squared error and correlation with the true log-odd ratio.

(a) shrinkage estimation improves the efficiency of the usual estimator of the log odds ratio for comparing mobility regimes, (b) shrinkage estimation also improves the efficiency of summary measures of association, such as the Altham indices, and (c) the benefits of shrinkage estimation depend on both the degree of heterogeneity in the log-oddds ratios and the variation in the sample size across regimes.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, in comparing mobility tables, the shrinkage estimators of log-oddds ratios and the Altham indices provide a more efficient way to estimate mobility parameters and to assess mobility differences across regimes and countries than does the usual maximum likelihood estimation.

the shrinkage estimation of log-od ds ratios and the Altham indices is an effective way to improve the precision of cross-table comparisons and to enhance the accuracy of summary measures of association for mobility tables.

the proposed shrinkage estimator of log-oddd ratios and the adjusted estimator of Altham index are both useful for comparing mobility tables, especially when the number of tables is large and the sample size in each table varies considerably.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the context of mobility tables, the usual MLE of the log-odd ratio is not the best choice for estimating the log-odr ratio.

, in the absence of strong prior knowledge about the pattern of association in a set of mobility tables, the shrinkage estimators of log-oddds ratios and the associated summary measures of association can improve the precision and accuracy of cross-table comparison.
shrinkage estimation can be used to improve both the efficiency and accuracy of the analysis of mobility tables.
